articles.title: Investors sue Selena Gomez alleging fraud tied to her mental health startup

articles.title: Flock says its new tool will help identify police abuse, but hasn’t explained how it works
articles.summary: The surveillance company announced it's making a tool called "Audit Assistance" mandatory for all customers, claiming it's already helped catch abuse. But the company has yet to explain how the tool works in detail, raising questions about its effectiveness.
